questions.prompt: Why can the runner not exit the first time the top agent becomes idle?
options: The log is not written until the second idle
Helpers may still be running, and their answers will wake the top agent for another turn
The model always needs two turns
Standard output is not ready yet
questions.explanation: The top agent may end its turn while children work. Each child's answer arrives as a followup and starts a new turn, so the runner must keep checking.

questions.prompt: When does the loop in src/cli.ts break?
options: When the top agent first finishes a turn
After a fixed number of turns
When a pass waits for no descendants and the top agent is not running
questions.explanation: waitForTree returns false only if no descendant was busy. With the top agent idle too, nothing can wake anything, so the work is done.

questions.prompt: Why does the headless runner set approval to never?
options: No person is there to answer, so risky calls are refused instead of hanging on a question
It makes every tool call allowed
Approval would print to standard output
questions.explanation: Anything but a clear yes means no. With nobody to ask, never refuses at once rather than waiting forever.
